title: CI: run the four ci.yml jobs on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm (DEC-303 (a59) item 4, arm A)
description: DEC-303 (a59) item 4, arm A: glyph-cli CI moves to GitHub-hosted runners as ward-cli does, because the self-hosted ARM64 group did not pick up jobs (opum-ai/glyph-cli#197 and #198 checks sat queued for 35 minutes). One workflow-only change at the DEC-182 floor (CI workflow path class, floor sonnet): runs-on in the four ci.yml jobs (Docs, Tracker integrity, Check, Package) changes from [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64] to ubuntu-24.04-arm. No job is renamed (the four required contexts keep their names), no step, dependency or lockfile changes, and no ruleset or runner group is touched. If a step needs anything beyond this to run on a hosted runner, stop and report before committing. release.yml is out of scope.

acceptanceCriteria.text: the four ci.yml jobs declare runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm and the diff contains no other change (proof: git diff of .github/workflows/ci.yml shows exactly four runs-on lines)
the four job names Docs, Tracker integrity, Check and Package are unchanged and all four report SUCCESS on the pull request from its own head (proof: the check run names and conclusions)
no ruleset, runner group, dependency, lockfile or step change (proof: the file list of the pull request is ci.yml and the Quest record only)

implementationNotes: Landed 2026-11-26 in opum-ai/glyph-cli#199 (squash 46cf2ae2, head 2eb3752c): runs-on of the four ci.yml jobs changed from [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64] to ubuntu-24.04-arm because the self-hosted group did not pick jobs up (checks sat queued about 35 minutes). All four contexts (Docs, Tracker integrity, Check, Package) SUCCESS on the hosted runners at that head. One departure from the confined scope, ruled by the leader: the hosted ARM runner takes just over 5s for test/language-golden.test.ts 'a hostile global git config cannot move the fixture or the answer', so that one test got an explicit 30_000 ms timeout (second commit, no flag, bunfig or other test change).
finalSummary: CI moved to GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm (opum-ai/glyph-cli#199, 46cf2ae2): four runs-on lines, job names unchanged, all four contexts green on the PR head. AC3 (file list is ci.yml and the Quest record only) is NOT met as written and is left unchecked: the change also carries a one-test 30s timeout in test/language-golden.test.ts, needed because the hosted runner exceeded the default 5s, with the leader's explicit approval.

acceptanceCriteria.text: no ruleset, runner group, dependency, lockfile or step change (proof: the file list of the pull request is ci.yml and the Quest record only)
